selection.selection_reason: Prespecified complete sequential rerun after development frontend v0.16.0 full Patient/$everything pagination shared by direct FHIR and SMART, conservative demographic-only incomplete reads, and work-order v2 unknown-smoking/no-history-fallback correction. The Python harness calls the frontend reader through Node22 fetch. E1 200 patients, seed20261013/workers4; E2 30x5; E1 supplemental from that E2; E3 default/alternate/local; E4 mock10,50,100,500 then real1,2,4. Every prescribed stage and E3 child passed the30-patient/521-resource baseline. All200 E1 reads are complete. Same models, prompts, temperatures, seeds and verdict criteria; no best-run selection.
selection.excluded_runs_policy: All runs remain inventoried; interrupted, superseded and historical formal runs are retained but not pooled into this frozen correction cohort.
selection.load_caveat: Both modes use unchanged Backend v0.19.0 and frontend v0.16.0 complete-history/unknown-smoking prefill, replaying this selected E2. Levels and patient pools differ. The unchanged mock chooses first-enum/minimum-index values, so classification lacks disease semantics and duplicate indices trigger conservative fallback. Request error and replay/session failure are distinct descriptive local observations, not national capacity.
